note: Musselshell County does not zone; its About page says zoning ordinances exist only for the City of Roundup. Roundup publishes its Zoning Classification Map only as a PDF image (no queryable ArcGIS service found), and its zoning text is on Municode. No public zoning polygon service was found for the county or Roundup, and ArcGIS searches returned none for Musselshell or Roundup.
